items.title: National Christmas Tree Lighting: free ticket lottery closes November 4
items.when: Lottery open from October 28 at 10 a.m. ET until Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 3 p.m. ET. Winners are notified Thursday, November 12, 2026. The ceremony is December 3, 2026 on the Ellipse.
items.cost: Free to enter and free tickets.
items.booking: Enter online on the Recreation.gov ticket page for the ceremony. Each winner may receive up to five tickets; entering does not guarantee tickets.
items.family: Up to five tickets per winner covers many families. The release gives no start time and no age rules for children.

items.title: Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party: 25 nights at Magic Kingdom
items.when: Select nights November 8 to December 22, 2026: November 8, 9, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19, 20, 24, 25, 27 and 29; December 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 22. The party runs 7 p.m. to midnight; ticket holders may enter Magic Kingdom from 4 p.m.
items.cost: USD 189 to USD 229 per ticket plus tax, by date. Children ages 3 to 9 pay USD 10 less per ticket.
items.booking: Separate event ticket. Disney says tickets are limited and may not be available on the day of the event or earlier.
items.family: A late night for young children: the party ends at midnight. Check remaining nights on Disney's ticket page.

items.title: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland: every visitor needs a booked entry slot
items.when: Every day from Thursday, November 19, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, except Christmas Day. Most days 10 a.m. to 10 p.m., some days open at 11 a.m., noon or 2 p.m.; last entry 9:30 p.m.
items.cost: Off-Peak entry slots are free but must still be booked. Standard and Peak slots are paid; check the current price on the official ticket site.
items.booking: Pre-book a date and an hourly arrival slot for everyone, including children ("whether you're 2 or 92"). Advance prices apply until 23:59 the day before.
items.family: The final day, January 3, 2027, is billed as a Family Fun Day; details were not yet published.
items.source_label: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland tickets guide

items.title: ZooLights at Lincoln Park Zoo: four free Monday nights with a reservation
items.when: Friday, November 20, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, 4:30 to 9 p.m.; last entry 8 p.m. No ZooLights on Thanksgiving (November 26), Tuesdays December 1, 8 and 15, or December 24 and 25.
items.cost: Fixed-date tickets USD 7 to USD 12 per person bought in advance, by date; USD 20 bought on the day or for a flexible ticket. Free on Mondays November 23 and 30 and December 7 and 14 with a reservation.
items.booking: Everyone needs a ticket, including children and infants. Free Monday tickets are released one week ahead at 11 a.m. CT.
items.family: Because infants need a ticket too, count every child when booking a free Monday.

items.title: Bronx Zoo Holiday Lights: Children's Zoo Farmyard open at night for the first time
items.when: Select dates from November 21, 2026 to January 3, 2027. The zoo's page lists available nights on its tickets page.
items.cost: Admission price not shown on the event page; see the tickets page. The Holiday Train is USD 4 (USD 3 for members).
items.booking: Tickets are required and must be reserved in advance.
items.family: New for 2026: the Children's Zoo Farmyard opens during Holiday Lights, and a 2-in-1 ticket lets you arrive at 1 p.m. to see animals before the lights.

items.title: Boston's holiday tree arrives from Nova Scotia on Boston Common
items.when: Tuesday, November 24, 2026, 11 a.m. to noon, Boston Common (139 Tremont Street). The tree arrives by police escort at about 11 a.m.
items.booking: The city's listing names no tickets or registration.
items.family: Listed as family friendly. A short daytime event that suits children too young for the evening lighting.

items.title: Ford Holiday River Parade and river lighting, the day after Thanksgiving
items.when: Friday, November 27, 2026, 6 p.m., starting at the Tobin Center. Live broadcast at 7:05 p.m. from the Arneson River Theatre.
items.cost: A free viewing area is available. Seat tickets are sold online; the event page does not show their price, and tickets are non-refundable.
items.booking: Free viewing is first come, first served on the east side of the River Walk between Pecan Street and Richmond Avenue; bring your own chair.
items.family: Theme: "Holiday Wishes Come True". Bring chairs and arrive early for the free area.
items.source_label: San Antonio River Walk event page

items.title: Copley Square tree lighting with Santa, Rudolph and crafts
items.when: Monday, November 30, 2026, 5 to 6 p.m., Copley Square (560 Boylston Street), with the grand reopening of the renovated square.
items.booking: The city's listing names no tickets or registration.
items.family: Arts and crafts, Santa and Rudolph, and the Boston Children's Chorus. Afterward, cookies and photos with Santa at the Fairmont Copley Plaza at 6 p.m.

items.title: Boston Common Tree Lighting, then the Commonwealth Avenue Mall lights
items.when: Thursday, December 3, 2026, 6 to 8 p.m., Boston Common by the Visitor Information Center (139 Tremont Street). The Commonwealth Avenue Mall lights are scheduled to go on at about 8:15 p.m.
items.booking: The city's listing names no tickets or registration.
items.family: Listed as family friendly. The page does not describe children's activities.

items.title: Balboa Park December Nights: the city's free holiday festival
items.when: Friday, December 4, 2026, 4 to 10 p.m., and Saturday, December 5, 2026, noon to 10 p.m., Balboa Park.
items.booking: No ticket. The city warns of a fake online account asking for payment; it never asks for payment by Zelle or other person-to-person apps.
items.family: The Saturday noon start is the easier day with young children.
items.source_label: City of San Diego December Nights page
